name: Light Injection Pass
aliases: Volumetric Light (Sun Shafts and Lamp Glow)
definition: A GPU fragment-stage algorithm that renders volume illumination by traversing light rays, computing visibility via binary search on the A-Buffer, and compositing light samples into camera space.
summary: The Light Injection Pass precomputes in-scattered radiance into a 3D texture using shadow maps, distinguishing itself by separating lighting data population from final compositing.
